title: Applied AI & Automation Engineer
description: Join Aristocrat Gaming’s AI Products & Enablement team as an Applied AI & Automation Engineer and be part of a world-class company leading gaming innovation. At Aristocrat, we value the power of play and are committed to bringing happiness to life through our innovative products and solutions. This role offers an outstanding chance to work with top experts in the field and contribute to pioneering AI and automation projects. If you are ambitious, motivated, and eager to make a meaningful impact, this is the right place for you.What You'll Do:-Build and configure AI agents, skills, prompts, and automation workflows to defined requirements and acceptance criteria.Develop integrations and data connections to enterprise systems under the direction of the Lead AI Solution Architect.Write and run tests and evaluations to confirm accuracy, reliability, and safe behavior before release.Implement telemetry that tracks quality, cost, exceptions, and human overrides for each product.Create and maintain reusable components and templates that business builders and other engineers can apply.Document solutions, configurations, and runbooks, and support releases in partnership with Group IT.Participate in Scrum ceremonies and contribute estimates, demos, and improvement ideas.What We're Looking For:-Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information technology, or a related field.3+ years of software development or automation experience, including hands-on work with generative AI or LLM-based solutions..Experience with at least one of Azure OpenAI, Copilot Studio, Power Automate, Salesforce Flow or Agentforce, or similar AI and automation platforms.Familiarity with testing practices and version control (Github).Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and clear written English communication.This job description may have been reviewed and enhanced using AI-assisted tools to improve clarity, consistency, and inclusivity. All final content, role requirements and hiring decisions remain subject to human review and approval by Aristocrat.Compensation PhilosophyWe offer a comprehensive pay and benefits package designed to stay competitive in the market, support your wellbeing, and recognise your contribution to our success. Our approach is underpinned by a pay-for-performance belief in rewarding individual impact. Your specific compensation package will be determined by factors such as your skills, experience, qualifications, and location.Depending on your role and location, you may be eligible for annual bonuses and incentives, health and wellbeing benefits, paid time off, retirement plans, insurance coverage, and other local or statutory benefits.Specific details about compensation and benefits for this position will be discussed during the recruitment process.
